description: The entry quantity is the amount the served attachment order fixes for the period. A net-pay deduction; the order's one-third ceiling and the debtor's reserved living costs bind the court, not this catalogue.

references.title: 強制執行法 §115-1: 對於薪資或其他繼續性給付之債權所為強制執行…其效力及於扣押後應受及增加之給付; the attachment order on 自然人因提供勞務而獲得之繼續性報酬債權 不得逾各期給付數額三分之一, unless the execution court, weighing both sides' circumstances, departs from that ratio while reserving the debtor's 生活費用; under a 移轉命令 the employer (third-party garnishee) pays the attached portion to the creditor, otherwise as the order directs. §115-1 predates every version. The one-third ceiling binds the court's order, not the employer: the employer deducts exactly the amount the served order fixes for the period, entered by HR with the order as evidence. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on how the garnishee books the deduction; default a net-pay deduction after every statutory line, touching no wage, insured, pension or tax base — lawful because the attached claim is the worker's wage itself, so tax and insurance stay on the whole wage (所得稅法 §14, 勞保條例 §14). Remittance to the creditor or court is an external payment.
